reviews.one_line_contribution: A train-by-infer 2x2 on fixed trajectories (memory block present/absent during LoRA SFT x present/absent/swapped/decoy at inference) that decomposes the reported gain of memory-in-the-loop agent training into absorbed content, untrained in-context read benefit, a learned read skill (the interaction term), and bank co-adaptation, with the pre-registered claim that the read skill is null and that training with memory is a crutch that displaces internalization.
reviews.closest_prior_work: UCOB (arXiv:2606.29502, verified via Semantic Scholar, 2026-06-28) is the sharpest threat: it trains with credit-aware bidirectional self-distillation *between skill-conditioned and no-skill prompts* on ALFWorld and WebShop and reports +23.5 over skill-free RL. That machinery only exists because the conditioned/unconditioned gap is real and closable, so UCOB pre-empts the surprise value of P2 (crutch) and P5 (the T_mix fix) on the proposal's own primary benchmark — and its fix is stronger than the RAFT-style mixing the proposal proposes, yet is not run. Two more: SESA (arXiv:2607.29468, verified S2, 2026-07-31) explicitly concludes that evolving skill memory 'is not merely an inference-time plug-in: it changes policy learning and the future training distribution while retaining value as optional external memory' — a directional answer to the proposal's central question in a different domain; and Experience Distillation (arXiv:2607.21051, verified S2, 2026-07-23) shows internalizing agent interaction histories into weights preserves most in-context learning gains, which is the proposal's 'content absorbed' channel already measured. None of these runs the same-trajectory memory-stripped control, the interaction term, or the bank swap, so the specific factorial is still open; what is no longer open is that the phenomena the proposal predicts are plausible and partly documented. arXiv:2603.18272 (verified S2) is correctly identified as the closest recipe and does appear to lack the memory-removed and swapped-bank cells.
reviews.strongest_objection: Bank A is built from the train-A successes, and T_M is fine-tuned to *generate* those same train-A trajectories. Leave-one-task-out only blocks the current task's own trajectory; every other bank-A item is a generation target somewhere else in the epoch. So at evaluation T_M reads a bank whose items it was explicitly trained to reproduce, while bank B contains items it has never generated. P3 (co-adaptation) is therefore pre-determined: T_M's own-bank-minus-swapped-bank drop will exceed Base's for the trivial reason that its own bank is memorized training output, not because it learned a bank-specific read policy. The same overlap contaminates T_M(A) in the read-skill term (there it biases toward *rejecting* the null, so a null P1 would survive, but a positive P1 would be uninterpretable) and inflates the whole 'own bank' column. Secondarily, the paper wants to correct a literature (MemHarness, AgeMem, SLEA-RL, UCOB, SAGE arXiv:2512.17102) none of whose objectives it implements: T_M is a home-built retrieval-aware LoRA SFT recipe, and the only cell resembling those methods is a 300-step GRPO arm marked 'budget permitting'. A null read-skill in a weak surrogate does not refute MemHarness's intrinsic-capability claim, and reviewers will say so.
reviews.what_would_fix_it: (1) Partition train-A into a bank pool and a target pool so no bank-A item is ever an SFT target, and build bank B the same way from train-B; then the swap contrast measures adaptation to a bank's *distribution*, not memorization of its contents. Re-run Gate 0's equivalence check on T_0 as well as Base. (2) Add a training-time control that fixes prompt length and structure while destroying memory relevance (see missing baseline) so 'crutch' is separated from 'long distracting prefix hurts SFT'. (3) Promote the GRPO arm from optional to required and implement one named objective faithfully — MemHarness's reconstruction reward or UCOB's conditioned/no-skill self-distillation — so the negative claim lands on a method the field recognizes; also run UCOB-style self-distillation as a competitor to T_mix in P5. (4) Fix the statistics: the TOST margin (3 points) equals the stated minimum detectable effect (3-4 points), so P1's equivalence test is being run at the edge of its own resolution; either increase episodes/seeds until the CI half-width is well under the margin, or justify the margin from an effect size in the literature rather than from the noise floor. (5) Report the interaction term on a non-templated second environment (WebShop is currently only a 'planned extension'), since ALFWorld saturation is acknowledged as the mechanism that would compress all four contrasts to nothing.
reviews.missing_baseline: T_D: SFT on the identical train-A trajectories with a relevance-matched decoy block of matched token length in the prompt (the training-time analogue of the decoy bank D, which currently exists only at inference). Without it, the crutch contrast T_0(none) - T_M(none) confounds 'the model offloaded to retrievable memory' with 'SFT under a long, partly irrelevant prefix produces a worse memory-free policy', and the proposal's headline interpretation collapses. A second omission: no memory-free distillation / self-distillation arm (UCOB 2606.29502, Experience Distillation 2607.21051) as a competitor to T_mix in P5, even though both are published on this benchmark family and both dominate RAFT-style mixing a priori.
reviews.preprint_collision: No verified collision. Channels used, all (a) the literature CLI (Semantic Scholar + HuggingFace); WebSearch unavailable in this session, WebFetch never used. Queries: (1) 'agent fine-tuned with retrieved memory in context evaluated without memory at inference crutch' --recent -> 2607.13591, 2606.24595, 2606.22844, 2606.05684, 2606.06036, 2605.21463, 2605.10268, 2602.16313, 2512.13564, 2507.05257; nothing removes only the memory from a fixed training set. (2) 'retrieval-augmented fine-tuning makes model rely on retrieval degrades parametric knowledge when context removed' (no date restriction) -> 2608.12218 (Information Abundance Paradox: long-context training reduces parametric knowledge encoding and increases contextual reliance), 2604.00715, 2503.15888, 2501.18365, 2310.01352, 2410.05983. (3) 'does training with memory teach a skill or absorb content ablation swap memory bank trained agent' --recent -> 2608.14036 (Demystifying Agent Skills: skills work by procedural anchoring, not knowledge injection), 2607.29468 (SESA), 2606.29502 (UCOB), 2607.01224, 2606.03197. (4) 'internalize retrieved experience into weights memory-free inference distillation agent retains gain without retrieval' --recent -> 2607.21051 (Experience Distillation), 2608.00017, 2603.13017. (5) 'retrieval-aware fine-tuning agent experience bank ablation trained model evaluated with different bank' -> 2603.18272, 2603.28716, 2605.27881, 2605.05726. IDs verified with `s2cli.py paper`: 2603.18272 (S2), 2607.28272 (HF, MemHarness title/TLDR only — abstract still not retrievable, so the proposal's characterization of its intrinsic-reasoning claim remains unconfirmed), 2601.01885 (HF), 2606.29502 (S2), 2603.18079 (S2), 2512.17102 (HF), 2608.12218 (S2), 2607.21051 (S2), 2607.29468 (S2). Not verified by id lookup: 2608.14036 — it surfaced in the HF search channel with title and TLDR, but the per-id `paper` call returned empty, so treat it as unverified. Judging the proposal's own check: it is above average — it names three query strings, lists returned IDs, distinguishes what it verified from what it could not (MemHarness), and states the network constraints honestly. But it is thin in three specific ways that matter. It ran only three queries through a single channel; it never searched the contextual-reliance-vs-parametric-knowledge framing, which is where the closest phenomenon-level neighbour lives (2608.12218, 2026-08-12, available before this proposal was written and absent from the check); and it cites UCOB only as 'compares against skill-free RL with different data' without noticing that UCOB's mechanism is distillation between skill-conditioned and no-skill prompts, i.e. a published fix for the proposal's own P2/P5 on ALFWorld. It also missed 2607.21051 and 2607.29468, both of which report partial answers to the content-absorption and memory-free-deployment questions. The factorial itself (interaction term plus bank swap, in weights) I could not find published, so novelty is scored on the packaging surviving while the individual phenomena have neighbours.
